meta.title: Upload your prompts
meta.description: Post the prompt you refined so other developers can find it, preview it and drop it into their repo. Sign in, fill in the form and it gets its own page.

hero.title: You already wrote something other developers would love.
hero.lead: That CLAUDE.md you tuned over dozens of sessions, the Cursor rule your whole team relies on, the agent playbook that finally just works: it saves hours for people who haven’t written it yet. Post it here and give it a page of its own.
hero.note: No audience needed. Just the file and a free account.

benefits.title: Everything is set up so your work gets noticed
benefits.lead: You focus on the prompt. mdstore gives it a proper home.

ownPage.title: A page of its own
ownPage.text: Your prompt gets its own address with its summary, highlights, suggested use and the tools you tested it with.

freePreview.title: You choose the preview
freePreview.text: Pick how many opening lines visitors read first, so the quality of your writing does the convincing.

credit.title: Your name on it
credit.text: Every post shows its author, so the developers who use your file know who to thank.

outputExamples.title: Show what it produces
outputExamples.text: Screenshots of the results your prompt gets are coming to every page. Keep a few handy.

plainMarkdown.title: Plain Markdown, no lock-in
plainMarkdown.text: You upload the same .md you already use. Developers download it and drop it into their repo.

listing.title: Small and specific beats big and vague
listing.lead: You don’t need a masterpiece. A prompt that does one job well is exactly what developers are looking for.

oneJob.title: Pick one narrow job
oneJob.text: “Improve the UX of a form” is easier to trust, and to use, than “make my whole app better”.

testedTools.title: Say what you tested it with
testedTools.text: Mark the AI tools you used it with, such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot, so developers know it works.

technologies.title: Name the technologies
technologies.text: Frameworks, languages and styling approaches it supports help the right developers find it.

results.title: Keep a few results handy
results.text: A screenshot or two of what the prompt built is the strongest way to show it’s worth it.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.text: Create a free account, or sign in if you already have one.

describe.title: Describe your prompt
describe.text: Fill in the form below: what it does, who it’s for, how to use it, and the .md file itself.

publish.title: Go live
publish.text: Your prompt is posted straight away on its own page, ready for developers to find.

form.title: Post your prompt
form.lead: Not sure it’s good enough? Post it anyway. If it made your own work easier, it will make someone else’s easier too.

signedOut.text: Sign in to post a prompt. It takes a minute and it’s free.

title.label: Title
title.hint: What the prompt is, in a few words (shown as the page heading).

tagline.label: Tagline
tagline.hint: One sentence that tells developers why they want it.

summary.label: Summary
summary.hint: What the prompt covers, in two or three sentences.

authorHandle.label: Author name or handle
authorHandle.hint: Shown on the page as the author, e.g. @yourname.

meantFor.label: Meant for
meantFor.hint: The kinds of projects it suits, one per line (e.g. Next.js App Router).

highlights.label: Highlights
highlights.hint: What the prompt makes the agent do, one per line.

usageSteps.label: Suggested use
usageSteps.hint: The steps to start using it, one per line. Wrap file names in `backticks`.

worksWith.label: Tested with
worksWith.hint: The AI tools you used it with.

previewLineCount.label: Free preview length (lines)
previewLineCount.hint: How many opening lines visitors read before downloading.

form.fixFields: Some fields need a change before posting. They’re marked below.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again to post your prompt.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, quote this code: {requestId}.
errors.notConfigured: Posting isn’t available yet. Please try again later.

validation.tooFewItems: Add at least {min, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}.
validation.handleFormat: Use letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, optionally starting with @.
validation.fileType: Choose a Markdown file ending in .md.
validation.fileTooLarge: Choose a file up to 200 KB.
validation.fileEmpty: The file is empty. Choose the file with your prompt.
